Vertical 9:16 photorealistic lifestyle film. Product: the exact handbag shown in the uploaded reference image, with its original visible shape, colour, handles, proportions and markings unchanged. Setting: shaded outdoor café pickup counter at late afternoon. Subject: one adult Universal Malaysian woman, framed from shoulders to mid-thigh, wearing plain neutral clothing; face stays outside frame. She uses only the handbag's visibly existing carrying parts. Natural warm daylight, restrained waist-height lateral tracking, realistic weight, grip and gravity. No invented pockets, closures, accessories, product claims, text, subtitles, logos or watermark.
EXACTLY 10 SECONDS:
0–2s: Open on the actual handbag resting upright on the empty chair beside the woman; show its front and original handles clearly.
2–5s: She grips the existing handles and lifts the handbag once, allowing its body to settle naturally against her hip.
5–8s: She walks three unhurried steps toward the pickup counter, with the bag unobstructed in the foreground.
8–10s: She stops beside the counter; finish on a stable three-quarter hero view of the handbag.
AUDIO: Off-camera Malaysian Malay female narrator, model silent: "Keluar kerja, singgah sekejap. Beg tetap jadi perhatian." Quiet café ambience.
